name: Generic Protein & Veg Tray Bake / Stir-Fry
notes: This is the default template. Swap the protein and seasoning to rotate without thinking. Protein swaps instead of 200g chicken thighs: chicken breast ~330 kcal, prawns 200g ~160 kcal, tuna 2 tins ~220 kcal, turkey mince 200g ~280 kcal. Seasoning options: Nando's sauce, soy + garlic, lemon + herbs, or fajita spice. Tray bake: 200°C, 35–40 mins. Stir-fry: high heat, 10 mins. Peas are the highest-carb veg here — skip them if you want to cut another 40 kcal and 7g carbs. Macros shown are for chicken thighs; adjust if swapping protein.
